---
title: "Examples"
---

SCGSim owns runtime, not duplicate public notebook source. OrPen SC PDK owns
the public component-simulation examples and imports `scgsim.palace`,
`scgsim.aedt`, and `scgsim.sgb`.

## Workflow categories

| Category | Canonical OrPen source | State |
|---|---|---|
| Palace Route A/B Electrostatic and Eigenmode | `notebooks/ComponentSimulation/Kosen2024_Xmon/` | Implemented, converging |
| HFSS Driven Terminal/Modal and Eigenmode | `notebooks/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/` | Implemented, converging |
| Q3D | `notebooks/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/` | Implemented, converging |
| Q2D | `notebooks/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/` | Implemented, converging |

The package-owned [Eigenmode and Offline EPR](eigenmode-epr.qmd) page records
the current Palace and AEDT APIs, normalization and loss assumptions, and
static snippets using the public OrPen Xmon component. Those snippets are not
claims of native solver validation. The public PDK notebooks remain the
canonical source for full component-simulation workflows.

Browse the [OrPen SC PDK notebooks at the source revision used by the static
example](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/orpen-sc-pdk/tree/50b59e6e44953a5c6b5d760c3c496cb4c2f31264/notebooks).

The canonical section names and stage ordering remain in
[Notebook UX Contracts](notebook-ux.qmd). Backend availability and remaining
scope are in the [Backend Support Matrix](backend-support.qmd).

## Evidence boundary

A public example may link its source notebook, exact source revision, run
receipt, artifacts, physical results, convergence diagnostics, cost, and
provenance only when each item has publication authority. Private
consumer names, paths, dimensions, screenshots, meshes, configs, receipts,
artifacts, and unpublished results never belong on this site.
